summary.description: Two or three sentences: what was reviewed, and whether any P1 exists. Say so explicitly if there is no P1 rather than inflating a P2.

severity.description: P1 = privacy leak, security hole, data loss, or a false 'removed' report, reachable in normal or plausible-adversarial use. P2 = real bug with a narrower blast radius. P3 = worth fixing, not urgent.

line.description: Real line number, verified by reading the file.

trigger.description: Concrete inputs or state that reach it.
